title: 🤔 चुनमुन के पास एक ही अखरोट बचा... एक न गिनो तो गिनती कैसे शुरू? #hindikids #ginti
title_alts: ✨ चुनमुन का एक अखरोट, एक चाँद, एक नाक... सबसे पहला अंक कौन सा? #hindikids #ginti
💡 चुनमुन एक भूल जाए तो टोकरी खाली लगती है... एक कैसे पहचानें? #hindikids #ginti
refrain: एक ही है, एक बोलो, एक!
description_hook: गिनती की शुरुआत एक से होती है। चुनमुन गिलहरी के एक अखरोट के साथ बच्चे एक पहचानना और बोलना सीखते हैं।

characters.name: चुनमुन
characters.description: four year old squirrel child, brown striped back and grey fur, tiny red cloth shoulder bag, bushy curled tail

scenes.narration: आज हम एक सीखेंगे। चुनमुन गिलहरी के पास एक अखरोट बचा है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn one. Chunmun the squirrel has one walnut left.
scenes.image_brief: a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail, sitting beside a shallow woven basket on a wide tree branch, one single walnut resting inside the basket. Soft morning light filtering through green leaves, calm cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: एक, एक। बोलो एक। एक का मतलब सिर्फ़ एक चीज़, और कोई नहीं।
scenes.caption: One, one. Say one. One means just a single thing and nothing more.
scenes.image_brief: A single walnut resting alone in the middle of a flat wooden board on the tree branch, wide empty space all around it, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail touching the walnut with one paw. Warm clear daylight.

scenes.narration: देखो, टोकरी में एक अखरोट है। बस एक। गिनो, एक।
scenes.caption: Look, one walnut sits in the basket. Just one. Count it, one.
scenes.image_brief: The shallow woven basket tilted so its mostly empty floor shows, exactly one walnut inside, on the sunlit tree branch, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail holding the basket rim with both paws. Bright clear daylight.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ बोलो। ऊँगली उठाओ और कहो, एक!
scenes.caption: Now say it with me. Lift one finger and say, one!
scenes.image_brief: a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail, holding up exactly one paw finger beside the single walnut on the wooden board on the branch, inviting friendly mood, bright midday light, blue sky behind the leaves.

scenes.narration: एक ही है, एक बोलो, एक!
scenes.caption: There is only one. Say one. One!
scenes.image_brief: The single walnut sitting in a bright pool of sunlight on the wooden board, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail sitting upright beside it with both paws pressed together. Golden light, happy settled mood.

scenes.narration: एक चाँद आसमान में चमकता है। आसमान में एक ही चाँद। एक।
scenes.caption: One moon shines up in the sky. Only one moon there. One.
scenes.image_brief: One round full moon alone in a deep indigo night sky above the same tree branch, the woven basket resting below, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail looking up at the single moon. Cool silver moonlight, peaceful mood.

scenes.narration: तुम्हारी नाक भी एक है। छुओ। एक नाक, एक अखरोट, एक चाँद।
scenes.caption: You have one nose too. Touch it. One nose, one walnut, one moon.
scenes.image_brief: a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail, touching her own single nose with one paw while sitting on the branch beside the one walnut, the moon still faintly visible in a pale sky. Soft pink early light.

scenes.narration: टोकरी में एक अखरोट है या दो? एक! सिर्फ़ एक अखरोट।
scenes.caption: One walnut in the basket, or two? One! Just one walnut.
scenes.image_brief: Two choices side by side on the wooden board, one walnut on the left and two walnuts on the right, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail standing next to the left side. Even bright daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: आज हमने एक सीखा। एक अखरोट, एक चाँद, एक नाक। एक ही है, एक बोलो, एक!
scenes.caption: Today we learned one: one walnut, one moon, one nose. One only, say one!
scenes.image_brief: Three things in a neat row on the sunlit branch, one walnut, one round moon painted on a wide leaf, and one small round mirror, a small grey squirrel with a brown striped back, a tiny red cloth shoulder bag and a bushy curled tail sitting proudly behind the row. Warm golden light.

title: 😊 हीरू के दो कान, पर गिनती एक पर रुकी... जोड़ी कैसे बनेगी? #hindikids #ginti
title_alts: 💡 हीरू के दो कान, दो चप्पल, दो पहिए... दो का मतलब क्या है? #hindikids #ginti
🤔 हीरू एक के बाद रुक जाए तो चप्पल अधूरी रह जाती है... दो कैसे? #hindikids #ginti
description_hook: एक के बाद क्या आता है? हीरू हाथी के दो कान गिनते गिनते बच्चे दो पहचानना और जोड़ी बनाना सीखते हैं।

characters.name: हीरू
characters.description: five year old elephant calf, pale grey skin, blue cloth saddle blanket, one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck

scenes.narration: आज हम दो सीखेंगे। हीरू हाथी के बड़े कान गिनने हैं। दो।
scenes.caption: Today we learn two. We will count Heeru the elephant's big ears. Two.
scenes.image_brief: a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck, standing on soft mud beside a calm village pond, both wide ears spread out clearly. Soft early sunlight, green reeds behind him, gentle happy mood.

scenes.narration: दो, दो। बोलो दो। एक, और फिर एक और। यही दो है।
scenes.caption: Two, two. Say two. One, and then one more. That is two.
scenes.image_brief: Two smooth round pebbles placed apart on a flat stone slab at the pond edge, clear space between them, a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck nudging one pebble with his trunk tip. Bright morning light.

scenes.narration: हीरू के दो बड़े कान हैं। बाएँ एक, दाएँ एक। मिलाकर दो कान।
scenes.caption: Heeru has two big ears. One on the left, one on the right. Two ears.
scenes.image_brief: a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck, facing forward beside the pond with both ears held wide and flat so each ear is fully visible on either side of his head. Clear bright daylight, calm mood.

scenes.narration: अब तुम मेरे साथ गिनो। कान छुओ और बोलो, एक, दो!
scenes.caption: Now count along with me. Touch your ears and say, one, two!
scenes.image_brief: a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck, curling his trunk up to touch one ear while the other ear stays spread wide, standing on the sunlit mud bank of the village pond. Warm inviting light.

scenes.narration: एक और एक, मिलकर दो!
scenes.caption: One and one together make two!
scenes.image_brief: Two round pebbles now pushed side by side touching each other on the flat stone slab, a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck resting his trunk beside the pair. Golden sunlight on the wet stone, satisfied happy mood.

scenes.narration: चप्पल भी दो होती हैं। एक पैर, दूसरा पैर, दो। साइकिल के पहिए? दो।
scenes.caption: Slippers come in two as well. One foot, other foot, two. Cycle wheels? Two.
scenes.image_brief: A pair of small rubber slippers set neatly side by side on the pond step, and behind them an old bicycle leaning on a wall with both wheels visible, a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck standing near the slippers. Bright afternoon light.

scenes.narration: हीरू के कान एक हैं या दो? दो! हीरू के पूरे दो कान।
scenes.caption: Does Heeru have one ear, or two? Two! Heeru has two full ears.
scenes.image_brief: a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck, seen from the front, both wide ears spread evenly on each side, standing on the mud bank with the pond water behind him. Even clear daylight, questioning cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: आज हमने दो सीखा। दो कान, दो चप्पल, दो पहिए। एक और एक, मिलकर दो!
scenes.caption: Today we learned two: two ears, two slippers, two wheels. One and one make two!
scenes.image_brief: Three pairs laid out in a row on the flat stone slab at the pond, two pebbles, two small slippers, and two bicycle wheels leaning together, a plump young elephant calf with pale grey skin, a blue cloth saddle blanket on his back and one small bell on a yellow cord round his neck standing proudly behind them. Warm golden evening light.

title: 🚗 काजू का ऑटो तीन पहियों पर चलता है... दो पर रुको तो क्या छूटेगा? #hindikids #ginti
title_alts: ✨ काजू गिनता है तीन पहिए, तीन तालियाँ, तीन आम... तीन कहाँ छिपा है? #hindikids #ginti
💡 काजू दो के बाद रुक जाता है... तीन न बोलो तो ऑटो अधूरा क्यों? #hindikids #ginti
description_hook: दो के बाद कौन आता है? काजू खरगोश के तीन पहिए वाले ऑटो के साथ बच्चे तीन तक गिनना सीखते हैं।

characters.name: काजू
characters.description: five year old rabbit child, soft brown fur, long upright ears, green knitted scarf, one white patch over the left eye

scenes.narration: आज हम तीन सीखेंगे। काजू खरगोश ऑटो के पहिए गिन रहा है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn three. Kaju the rabbit is counting an auto rickshaw's wheels.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow and green three wheeled auto rickshaw parked at the edge of a quiet market lane, all three wheels clearly visible, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf crouching beside the front wheel. Soft morning sunlight, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: तीन, तीन। बोलो तीन। दो के बाद जो आता है, वही तीन।
scenes.caption: Three, three. Say three. The one that comes after two is three.
scenes.image_brief: Three round clay marbles set in a clear row on a flat stone step in the market lane, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf pointing at the last marble with one paw. Bright warm daylight, plain empty ground around them.

scenes.narration: ऑटो के पहिए गिनो। एक आगे, दो पीछे। तीन पहिए। बस तीन।
scenes.caption: Count the auto wheels. One in front, two behind. Three wheels. Just three.
scenes.image_brief: The yellow and green auto rickshaw seen from its side on the market lane so the single front wheel and both back wheels all show clearly, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf standing near the back wheels. Clear midday light.

scenes.narration: अब तुम मेरे साथ गिनो, ज़ोर से। एक, दो, तीन!
scenes.caption: Now count with me, out loud. One, two, three!
scenes.image_brief: a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf, holding up three paw fingers beside the parked yellow and green auto rickshaw in the market lane, an inviting cheerful mood. Bright sunlight, blue sky above the shop awnings.

scenes.narration: एक, दो, तीन, पूरे तीन!
scenes.caption: One, two, three, a full three!
scenes.image_brief: Three clay marbles pushed together in a tidy triangle on the flat stone step, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf resting one paw beside them. Golden sunlight on the stone, satisfied happy mood.

scenes.narration: तीन बार ताली बजाओ। एक, दो, तीन। तीन तालियाँ हो गईं।
scenes.caption: Clap your hands three times. One, two, three. That makes three claps.
scenes.image_brief: a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf, pressing both front paws together in a clap while standing in the market lane, three small chalk marks drawn on the wall behind him. Warm afternoon light, lively mood.

scenes.narration: स्टूल के पैर? तीन। कटोरी में तीन आम रखे हैं। तीन।
scenes.caption: Legs on a stool? Three. Three mangoes sit in the bowl. Three.
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden three legged stool on the market lane with a steel bowl on top holding exactly three ripe yellow mangoes, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf standing beside the stool. Bright clear afternoon light.

scenes.narration: अपनी तीन उँगलियाँ उठाओ। गिनो, एक, दो, तीन। शाबाश, पूरे तीन!
scenes.caption: Hold up three of your fingers. Count, one, two, three. Well done, three!
scenes.image_brief: a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf, holding three paw fingers up high beside the three legged stool with its bowl of three mangoes in the market lane. Warm golden light, proud joyful mood.

scenes.narration: ऑटो के पहिए दो हैं या तीन? तीन! ऑटो के तीन पहिए।
scenes.caption: Does the auto have two wheels, or three? Three! The auto has three wheels.
scenes.image_brief: The yellow and green auto rickshaw seen from a low angle on the market lane with all three wheels in view, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf sitting on the ground looking at the wheels. Even bright daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: आज हमने तीन सीखा। तीन पहिए, तीन तालियाँ, तीन आम। एक, दो, तीन, पूरे तीन!
scenes.caption: Today we learned three: three wheels, three claps, three mangoes. One, two, three!
scenes.image_brief: Three groups lined up on the market lane, three auto wheels, three chalk marks on the wall and three mangoes in a steel bowl, a young brown rabbit with long upright ears, one white patch over his left eye and a green knitted scarf sitting proudly in front of them. Warm golden evening light.

title: 🤔 मखना की कुर्सी डोल रही है... चार पैर न गिनो तो क्या छूटेगा? #hindikids #ginti
title_alts: 💡 मखना गिनता है चार पैर, चार पंजे, चार कोने... चार कहाँ दिखता है? #hindikids #ginti
✨ मखना तीन पर गिनती रोक दे, तो कुर्सी सीधी क्यों नहीं रहती? #hindikids #ginti
description_hook: तीन के बाद एक और जोड़ो तो चार बनता है। मखना मेंढक की कुर्सी के चार पैर गिनकर बच्चे चार पहचानते हैं।

characters.name: मखना
characters.description: four year old frog child, bright green skin, round yellow belly, tiny orange cloth cap, one dark spot on the right cheek

scenes.narration: आज हम चार सीखेंगे। मखना मेंढक कुर्सी के पैर गिन रहा है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn four. Makhna the frog is counting the chair's legs.
scenes.image_brief: A plain wooden chair standing on the flat stone floor of a sunny house courtyard, all four legs visible, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek sitting on the floor beside one chair leg. Soft warm morning light, calm mood.

scenes.narration: चार, चार। बोलो चार। तीन के बाद एक और, तो चार हो गए।
scenes.caption: Four, four. Say four. After three add one more, and it becomes four.
scenes.image_brief: Four white chalk sticks laid out evenly apart on the stone courtyard floor, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek placing the fourth chalk stick at the end of the row. Bright clear daylight, plenty of bare floor around them.

scenes.narration: कुर्सी के पैर गिनो। एक, दो, तीन, चार। पूरे चार पैर।
scenes.caption: Count the chair legs. One, two, three, four. Four whole legs.
scenes.image_brief: The plain wooden chair seen straight on in the sunny courtyard so each of its four legs stands clearly separate on the stone floor, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek touching the nearest leg. Clear bright daylight.

scenes.narration: अब तुम गिनो। पैर छुओ और बोलो, एक, दो, तीन, चार!
scenes.caption: Now you count. Touch the legs and say, one, two, three, four!
scenes.image_brief: a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek, hopping around the base of the wooden chair in the sunny courtyard with one webbed hand raised towards a chair leg. Warm inviting sunlight, lively friendly mood.

scenes.narration: चार पैर, चार गिनो, चार!
scenes.caption: Four legs, count four, four!
scenes.image_brief: The four chalk sticks now pushed together into a neat square shape on the stone courtyard floor, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek sitting upright beside them. Golden sunlight across the stone, settled happy mood.

scenes.narration: बिल्ली के पंजे भी चार हैं। एक, दो, तीन, चार। चार पंजे।
scenes.caption: A cat has four paws as well. One, two, three, four. Four paws.
scenes.image_brief: A sleepy striped cat lying stretched out on the warm stone courtyard floor with all four paws clearly spread apart, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek sitting a little away watching the paws. Soft afternoon light, gentle mood.

scenes.narration: रूमाल के चारों कोने गिनो। चार कोने मिले। मेज़ के पैर? चार।
scenes.caption: Count all four corners of a handkerchief. Four corners. Table legs? Four.
scenes.image_brief: A square cotton handkerchief spread flat on the courtyard floor with each of its four corners pulled out straight, a wooden table behind it showing four legs, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek pressing one corner down. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: कुर्सी के पैर तीन हैं या चार? चार! कुर्सी के चार पैर।
scenes.caption: Does the chair have three legs, or four? Four! The chair has four legs.
scenes.image_brief: The plain wooden chair alone in the middle of the sunny courtyard with its four legs and their four shadows on the stone floor, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek standing in front of it. Even bright daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: आज हमने चार सीखा। चार पैर, चार पंजे, चार कोने। चार पैर, चार गिनो, चार!
scenes.caption: Today we learned four: four legs, four paws, four corners. Four legs, count four!
scenes.image_brief: Three groups of four in a row in the sunny courtyard, the four legged wooden chair, the sleepy striped cat with four paws, and the square handkerchief with four corners, a small bright green frog with a round yellow belly, a tiny orange cloth cap and one dark spot on his right cheek sitting proudly before them. Warm golden light.
